The diff is purely static, human-readable copy added to a marketing/landing HTML page (`docs/index.html`). The added lines are text within `

` tags—no scripts, no attributes with dynamic content, no URLs, no user input, no server code, no sinks. There is no attacker-influenceable data flow, no authorization gate, no parser change.
